items.docs: BETACreate a work zone in a project, under an existing one (possibly the root work zone of the project). The new work zone automatically inherits the contributors (users and groups) from the parent work zone. **Requires** the permission `workzone` on the parent work zone.

params.name: allowRemoveOnParents
params.description:
If true the operation is allowed to remove from a parent.

If false and the operation needs to remove from a parent, a bad request error will be returned.

items.docs: BETARemove a user from a work zone and all child work zones. If the work zone is not the project's root work zone, and the user to remove is also a contributor on a parent work zone, the user must be removed from the parents for which he is a contributor. items.docs: BETACopy a work zone, its sub-work zones, and the files on these work zones. The destination of the copy is provided by: - `destinationProject`: if not provided or null, a new project is created, and the copied work zone will be the root work zone of the new project. - `destinationWorkzone`: if provided and not null, specify the work zone inside the destination project in which the copied work zone will be.
